# Aquin Anil — Portfolio profile

This document describes Aquin Anil’s portfolio using information supplied on the current portfolio and public GitHub profile. Project details are stated as they are known; unverified site details and private claims are not inferred.

## Identity
- Name: Aquin Anil
- Role: Student developer
- Location: Kerala, India
- Portfolio: https://v0-aquin.vercel.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/aquinanil79-web
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aquin-anil/
- Public contact: aquin.anil.dev@gmail.com

## About
Aquin is a self-taught full-stack web developer and Minecraft server developer from Kerala, India. He began learning through hands-on projects in 2021. His interests include modern web applications, AI-powered tools, workflow automation, and online communities. He is continuing to explore software development, AI, and cybersecurity.

## Areas of interest
Computer science; artificial intelligence; cybersecurity; web development.

## Selected projects
- **HubSmart** — featured live project at https://v0-hubsmart.vercel.app/. Its live site was not inspectable during this rebuild; feature, framework, and deployment details beyond the public URL are intentionally omitted.
- **Vortex SMP** — Minecraft SMP and server community project.
- **SMM Store** — social media marketing and growth platform/storefront.
- **Velora · AI Chat 3D** — React/Vite web project. Public repository: https://github.com/aquinanil79-web/aichat3d. Its README describes a separately hosted API and WebSocket service; the portfolio does not claim they are deployed.
- **Discord Bot Generator** — Discord bot creation and developer workflow project.
- **Legion Network Architecture** — Minecraft server infrastructure, proxy routing, plugin, permission, and operations work.
- **AI Knowledge & RAG Discord Bot** — concept for AI-assisted knowledge retrieval and community support.
- **Discord Bot Operations Suite** — Discord administration, tickets, slash commands, and community automation work.
- **PDF Utility Suite** — concept for client-side document processing.

## Technology and topics
The portfolio identifies React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Python, Java, HTML, CSS, GitHub, Vercel, Linux, Docker, and PostgreSQL among its web and project topics. AI applications, cybersecurity, and Minecraft infrastructure are areas of continued exploration; this is not a claim of equal proficiency across every technology.
